fields.statement: Bug 01M78TV0 (root daemon ~0.43 core idle, drivers up to ~0.15 core): which intent should it serve? Both earlier CPU fixes (01M6H6SG daemon fold cache, 01M6NE0X driver idle poll) landed and served m24-on-the-vm / milestone-25, neither on the roadmap now; open milestone 4's m4-orchestrated-by-rhiza is what the daemon load-hold fix (01M75T74) served. / How should the live daemon and drivers be profiled at idle? Today RHIZA_CPUPROFILE only profiles a process from start to exit, so the root service can't be profiled without a restart. / What should the idle CPU budgets and the CI-wait cadence be? The usage governor re-walks ~4,000 Claude transcript files (2.6 GB dir) each 5 s poll, once per project; ship-change's CI waits run a fresh 'rhiza ship check' process every 30 s.
